description: This Java class models the <condition> element in a widget framework, specifically handling 'if-empty-section' conditions within a screen model. It defines an immutable data structure for representing XML conditions and includes a factory for creating condition instances.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition
classes.description: Main class representing a screen condition, including nested classes for specific condition types and a factory for creating condition instances.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition.IfEmptySection
classes.description: Immutable class representing a condition that checks if a specific section is empty.

classes.name: ModelScreenCondition.ScreenConditionFactory
classes.description: Factory class for creating instances of conditions based on XML elements.

methods.name: accept
methods.description: Accepts a visitor to process this condition.

methods.name: eval
methods.description: Evaluates the condition against a given context map.

methods.name: getSectionExdr
methods.description: Returns the FlexibleStringExpander for the section name.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new condition instance based on an XML element.
